fieldValues.title: One framework of six classifications, each owned once, with local forms
fieldValues.move: Work is classified on six axes, each defined in one place: kind of item, value and order (derived), effort (one size and one complexity scale), state (one work-status set), authority (decision mode and door) and route (domain to group). A repository adds local forms (srs's Doors, srs-rust's ADRs) inside the framework, and retires labels and words that duplicate an axis.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Which kinds of decision exist (the decision-taxonomy exercise).
fieldValues.falsifier: Six months on, a tool still reads a classification the framework retired, or two repos use different words for one axis.
